messages:

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Checkout timeouts — spike observed in last 2 hours

Marissa / Dev,

We started seeing a big uptick in failed checkout completions starting around 06:40 PT — about 7% error rate on the completion endpoint and a subset of requests timing out after 10s. Customer impact: ~12% of carts dropped in the three consumer regions.

Attached are a small set of request traces and a CSV with request metadata. Our engineering team is seeing skewed latencies where most requests are fine but a long tail remains. Can you confirm if anything changed on your side (deploys, routing) and advise next steps?

Thanks,
Aditi Sharma
SRE, GlimmerPay

Attachments: latency-traces-0416.zip (zip), prefill-logs-0416.csv (csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Checkout timeouts — spike observed in last 2 hours

Quick triage notes (preliminary):
- Pattern looks like head-of-line queueing. KV cache miss rates increased in region-us-west-2 during the window, causing extra decoding and larger CPU stalls.
- We also observe instance-level concurrency caps hitting 250 reqs/instance on the dedicated pool GlimmerPay is routed to; tail requests are delayed waiting for available slots.
- Error rate correlates with requests that exceeded the 8s soft deadline and retried, causing amplification.

Attachments: latency-traces-0416.zip (same set) — I extracted the slow segments.

Proposed mitigations (short term):
1) Increase concurrency cap for the GlimmerPay route to 400 for 24 hours to drain the tail.
2) Apply aggressive prefix cache for common checkout prompts (reduce decodes on miss).
3) Reroute a fraction of traffic (10–20%) to a warm dedicated pool in another AZ to spread load.

I can push the concurrency bump as an emergency change if Marissa/ops approve.

—Karthik
Sr. Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Requesting rapid approval for the emergency cap increase and an OK to bill temporary surge credits as needed. Aditi from GlimmerPay is on the thread.

—Marissa

—Aditi
